'''The Big Quince''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. It was a sleepy bar, favored by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and drivers.<ref name="HNNA" />
